intents: Troubleshoot an IPv6 IS-IS domain where pc1 cannot reach pc2 because the r1-r2 adjacency does not form.
The lab starts with FRR and IPv6 addressing already present on r1 and r2.
Inspect the IS-IS state, running config, and IPv6 routes to identify the misconfiguration.
Fix the missing IS-IS activation on r2 eth2, the core-facing interface toward r1.
After the fix, r1 and r2 must form an IS-IS adjacency and exchange the LAN IPv6 prefixes.
Do not replace the addressing plan and do not modify management connectivity on eth0.

r2: vtysh -c 'configure terminal' -c 'interface eth2' -c 'ipv6 router isis CORE' -c 'isis network point-to-point' -c 'end'

ground_truth_reasoning: The IPv6 addressing and forwarding are already in place, but r2 eth2 is missing IS-IS activation, so no adjacency can form over the r1-r2 core link. The correct repair is to enter FRR configuration mode on r2, enable ipv6 router isis CORE under eth2, mark the link point-to-point, and then validate the neighbor table, LSDB-derived routes, and end-to-end IPv6 ping.

baseline_invariants.name: PC1 management interface is still up
R1 management interface is still up
R2 management interface is still up
PC2 management interface is still up

testcases.name: PC1 can ping PC2 after IS-IS repair
PC2 can ping PC1 after IS-IS repair

R2 sees R1 as an IS-IS neighbor
